question: Should this ClawHub issue be migrated or cross-linked to the OpenClaw runtime/browser tracker, or intentionally kept here as a support-routing issue?
rationale: The report is detailed and plausibly actionable, but the relevant gateway and managed-browser implementation is absent from ClawHub, so automation cannot choose the permanent routing or ownership boundary.

options.title: Route to runtime tracker
options.body: Move or cross-link the report to the OpenClaw browser/runtime area where the gateway, Chrome launch, and CDP readiness code can be changed.

options.title: Keep as ClawHub triage
options.body: Leave the issue open here only as a support-routing record, with no ClawHub fix PR expected.

options.title: Close after upstream tracking exists
options.body: Close this issue only after a runtime-owned issue or fix preserves the reporter's environment details and validation need.

recommendation.title: Route to runtime tracker
recommendation.body: Move or cross-link the report to the OpenClaw browser/runtime area where the gateway, Chrome launch, and CDP readiness code can be changed.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest ClawHub-side routing candidate from current blame and PR metadata on the scope docs and CLI surfaces.
